svg.title: Yarra Valley (VIC) study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Yarra Valley; 2: Gruyere; 3: Coldstream; 4: Lilydale; 5: Yarra Glen; 6: Yering; 7: Dixons Creek; 8: Healesville; 9: Hoddles Creek; 10: Seville; 11: Melbourne; 12: Cranbourne

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
